scope: 23 full terminal audits, 3 active runs using 40 H100s each. Fixed 51-run design; no quality conclusions. Both excluded failures remain in total cost and reliability. The controlled incumbent seed 102 repeat passed its first two applied updates; the prior Transformer Engine error remains unexplained.
further_submissions: Follow the frozen order, at most one job per minute; stop on failure, retry or priority mismatch, and back off when outside demand rises.
spare_policy: Keep 120 H100 spare: the ordinary 80 plus a 40 H100 allowance for peer fresh/resume phases. Provider snapshots include actual running allocations; no additional 152 H100 forecast allowance is active, and this policy does not reserve the pool.

controlled_repeat_first_two_updates.qualification: first two updates finite/nonzero, two actual optimizer updates in published ledgers
controlled_repeat_first_two_updates.limitation: No recurrence in these first two updates does not establish the cause of the previous failure or failure-free behavior.

operational_completion_policy.cost_basis: Original attempt allocation timestamps, excluding unallocated controller wait before native completion.
